title: Pokémon Lostlands | Demo Release Trailer
author: Baphaddon
selftext: Fully playable Pokemon ARPG based on Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles; would be happy to discuss workflows etc

comments.body: Assuming Nintendo doesn't come for your first born, I would be curious and maybe even try t come up with a VR mod for it.

comments.body:
So horrendous that even Nintendo wouldn't want to go after you for this shit. Good lord man.
